en.text: I will stand at my watch and set myself on the ramparts, and will look out to see what he will say to me, and what I will answer concerning my complaint.

zhSimplified.text: 我要站在守望所， 立在望楼上观看， 看耶和华对我说什么话， 我可用什么话向他诉冤。

footnotes.text: - 2:1 向他诉冤：或译回答所疑问的

zhTraditional.text: 我要站在守望所， 立在望樓上觀看， 看耶和華對我說甚麼話， 我可用甚麼話向他訴冤。

footnotes.text: - 2:1 向他訴冤：或譯回答所疑問的

en.text: The LORD answered me, “Write the vision, and make it plain on tablets, that he who runs may read it.

zhSimplified.text: 他对我说：将这默示明明地写在版上， 使读的人容易读。

zhTraditional.text: 他對我說：將這默示明明地寫在版上， 使讀的人容易讀。

en.text: For the vision is yet for the appointed time, and it hurries toward the end, and won’t prove false. Though it takes time, wait for it, because it will surely come. It won’t delay.

zhSimplified.text: 因为这默示有一定的日期， 快要应验，并不虚谎。 虽然迟延，还要等候； 因为必然临到，不再迟延。

zhTraditional.text: 因為這默示有一定的日期， 快要應驗，並不虛謊。 雖然遲延，還要等候； 因為必然臨到，不再遲延。

en.text: Behold, his soul is puffed up. It is not upright in him, but the righteous will live by his faith.

zhSimplified.text: 迦勒底人自高自大，心不正直； 惟义人因信得生。

zhTraditional.text: 迦勒底人自高自大，心不正直； 惟義人因信得生。

en.text: Yes, moreover, wine is treacherous: an arrogant man who doesn’t stay at home, who enlarges his desire as Sheol; he is like death and can’t be satisfied, but gathers to himself all nations and heaps to himself all peoples.

footnotes.text: 2:5 Sheol is the place of the dead.

zhSimplified.text: 迦勒底人因酒诡诈，狂傲， 不住在家中， 扩充心欲，好像阴间。 他如死不能知足， 聚集万国，堆积万民都归自己。

zhTraditional.text: 迦勒底人因酒詭詐，狂傲， 不住在家中， 擴充心欲，好像陰間。 他如死不能知足， 聚集萬國，堆積萬民都歸自己。

en.text: Won’t all these take up a parable against him, and a taunting proverb against him, and say, ‘Woe to him who increases that which is not his, and who enriches himself by extortion! How long?’

zhSimplified.text: 这些国的民岂不都要提起诗歌并俗语讥刺他说： 祸哉！迦勒底人，你增添不属自己的财物， 多多取人的当头，要到几时为止呢？

zhTraditional.text: 這些國的民豈不都要提起詩歌並俗語譏刺他說： 禍哉！迦勒底人，你增添不屬自己的財物， 多多取人的當頭，要到幾時為止呢？

en.text: Won’t your debtors rise up suddenly, and wake up those who make you tremble, and you will be their victim?

zhSimplified.text: 咬伤你的岂不忽然起来， 扰害你的岂不兴起， 你就作他们的掳物吗？

zhTraditional.text: 咬傷你的豈不忽然起來， 擾害你的豈不興起， 你就作他們的擄物嗎？

en.text: Because you have plundered many nations, all the remnant of the peoples will plunder you because of men’s blood, and for the violence done to the land, to the city and to all who dwell in it.

zhSimplified.text: 因你抢夺许多的国，杀人流血， 向国内的城并城中一切居民施行强暴， 所以各国剩下的民都必抢夺你。

zhTraditional.text: 因你搶奪許多的國，殺人流血， 向國內的城並城中一切居民施行強暴， 所以各國剩下的民都必搶奪你。

en.text: Woe to him who gets an evil gain for his house, that he may set his nest on high, that he may be delivered from the hand of evil!

zhSimplified.text: 为本家积蓄不义之财、 在高处搭窝、指望免灾的有祸了！

zhTraditional.text: 為本家積蓄不義之財、 在高處搭窩、指望免災的有禍了！

en.text: You have devised shame to your house by cutting off many peoples, and have sinned against your soul.

zhSimplified.text: 你图谋剪除多国的民，犯了罪， 使你的家蒙羞，自害己命。

zhTraditional.text: 你圖謀剪除多國的民，犯了罪， 使你的家蒙羞，自害己命。

en.text: For the stone will cry out of the wall, and the beam out of the woodwork will answer it.

zhSimplified.text: 墙里的石头必呼叫； 房内的栋梁必应声。

zhTraditional.text: 牆裏的石頭必呼叫； 房內的棟樑必應聲。

en.text: Woe to him who builds a town with blood, and establishes a city by iniquity!

zhSimplified.text: 以人血建城、 以罪孽立邑的有祸了！

zhTraditional.text: 以人血建城、 以罪孽立邑的有禍了！

en.text: Behold, isn’t it from the LORD of Armies that the peoples labor for the fire, and the nations weary themselves for vanity?

zhSimplified.text: 众民所劳碌得来的被火焚烧， 列国由劳乏而得的归于虚空， 不都是出于万军之耶和华吗？

zhTraditional.text: 眾民所勞碌得來的被火焚燒， 列國由勞乏而得的歸於虛空， 不都是出於萬軍之耶和華嗎？

en.text: For the earth will be filled with the knowledge of the LORD’s glory, as the waters cover the sea.

zhSimplified.text: 认识耶和华荣耀的知识要充满遍地， 好像水充满洋海一般。

zhTraditional.text: 認識耶和華榮耀的知識要充滿遍地， 好像水充滿洋海一般。

en.text: “Woe to him who gives his neighbor drink, pouring your inflaming wine until they are drunk, so that you may gaze at their naked bodies!

zhSimplified.text: 给人酒喝、又加上毒物、 使他喝醉、好看见他下体的有祸了！

zhTraditional.text: 給人酒喝、又加上毒物、 使他喝醉、好看見他下體的有禍了！

en.text: You are filled with shame, and not glory. You will also drink and be exposed! The cup of the LORD’s right hand will come around to you, and disgrace will cover your glory.

zhSimplified.text: 你满受羞辱，不得荣耀； 你也喝吧，显出是未受割礼的！ 耶和华右手的杯必传到你那里； 你的荣耀就变为大大地羞辱。

zhTraditional.text: 你滿受羞辱，不得榮耀； 你也喝吧，顯出是未受割禮的！ 耶和華右手的杯必傳到你那裏； 你的榮耀就變為大大地羞辱。

en.text: For the violence done to Lebanon will overwhelm you, and the destruction of the animals will terrify you, because of men’s blood and for the violence done to the land, to every city and to those who dwell in them.

zhSimplified.text: 你向黎巴嫩行强暴与残害 惊吓野兽的事必遮盖你； 因你杀人流血， 向国内的城并城中一切居民施行强暴。

zhTraditional.text: 你向黎巴嫩行強暴與殘害 驚嚇野獸的事必遮蓋你； 因你殺人流血， 向國內的城並城中一切居民施行強暴。

en.text: “What value does the engraved image have, that its maker has engraved it; the molten image, even the teacher of lies, that he who fashions its form trusts in it, to make mute idols?

zhSimplified.text: 雕刻的偶像，人将它刻出来， 有什么益处呢？ 铸造的偶像就是虚谎的师傅。 制造者倚靠这哑巴偶像有什么益处呢？

zhTraditional.text: 雕刻的偶像，人將它刻出來， 有甚麼益處呢？ 鑄造的偶像就是虛謊的師傅。 製造者倚靠這啞巴偶像有甚麼益處呢？

en.text: Woe to him who says to the wood, ‘Awake!’ or to the mute stone, ‘Arise!’ Shall this teach? Behold, it is overlaid with gold and silver, and there is no breath at all within it.

zhSimplified.text: 对木偶说：醒起！ 对哑巴石像说：起来！那人有祸了！ 这个还能教训人吗？ 看哪，是包裹金银的，其中毫无气息。

zhTraditional.text: 對木偶說：醒起！ 對啞巴石像說：起來！那人有禍了！ 這個還能教訓人嗎？ 看哪，是包裹金銀的，其中毫無氣息。

en.text: But the LORD is in his holy temple. Let all the earth be silent before him!”

zhSimplified.text: 惟耶和华在他的圣殿中； 全地的人都当在他面前肃敬静默。

zhTraditional.text: 惟耶和華在他的聖殿中； 全地的人都當在他面前肅敬靜默。
